item.title: security: Email threat landscape: Q2 2026 trends and insights
item.description:
Microsoft reports that Q2 2026 saw continued declines in several phishing techniques after disruption of the Tycoon2FA platform. Attackers shifted toward Teams-based social engineering and more automated, multi-stage attack chains.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: security: Microsoft Defender email security benchmarking: Key insights from one year of data
item.description:
Microsoft published a blog post summarizing one year of real-world email security benchmarking for Microsoft Defender, comparing its performance against SEG and ICES vendors. The provided excerpt does not include the specific results or metrics.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog
